#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> l(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> l[i];
        l[i] %= k;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        cout << l[0] << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    std::vector<int> l1, l2;
    l1.assign(l.begin(), l.begin() + n / 2);
    l2.assign(l.begin() + n / 2, l.end());

    std::set<int> s, s1;
    std::set<int> s2;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)l1.size(); ++i) {
        for (auto j : s) {
            s2.insert((j + l1[i]) % k);
        }
        s.insert(l1[i]);
        for (auto j : s2) {
            s.insert(j);
        }
        s2.clear();
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)l2.size(); ++i) {
        for (auto j : s1) {
            s2.insert((j + l2[i]) % k);
        }
        s1.insert(l2[i]);
        for (auto j : s2) {
            s1.insert(j);
        }
        s2.clear();
    }

    std::vector<int> s_vec(s.begin(), s.end());
    std::vector<int> s1_vec(s1.begin(), s1.end());

    int ans = *max_element(s_vec.begin(), s_vec.end());
    int max_s1 = *max_element(s1_vec.begin(), s1_vec.end());

    for (auto a : s_vec) {
        int t = k - 1 - a;
        int ind = (int)std::lower_bound(s1_vec.begin(), s1_vec.end(), t) - s1_vec.begin();
        int r = (ind == 0) ? s1_vec[0] : s1_vec[ind - 1];
        int rt = s1_vec.back();
        int temp_ans = max((r + a) % k, (a + rt) % k);
        ans = max({ans, temp_ans, max_s1});
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
